title: Micro-Lesson: How Derivatives Help AI Learn From Mistakes

learning_design.learning_goal: Understand derivative as direction for reducing AI error.
learning_design.why_it_matters: This is the intuition behind model training.
learning_design.memory_anchor: Derivative tells AI which way to adjust.
learning_design.quick_check: If error increases, should AI keep adjusting the same way?

voiceover.voice_name: Zara - Soft and Serene Indian Voice
voiceover.text: In this micro lesson, you will learn how derivatives help AI reduce mistakes. Why it matters: training AI means reducing error. Think of a missed basketball shot. The miss tells you which way to adjust. In math, a derivative is slope at one point. It tells how a tiny change affects the result. In AI, the model predicts, checks the correct answer, and measures error. The derivative points toward lower error. So AI takes a small step, checks again, and repeats. Remember: derivative tells AI which way to adjust.
